Tubi continues to quietly host some of the best free movies available anywhere, and this list proves it.

In this video, I’m highlighting near perfect movies to watch free on Tubi—films that may not be universally labeled “perfect,” but come shockingly close. These are critically respected, endlessly rewatchable movies across crime, action, sci-fi, drama, and more. You’ll find everything from genre-defining classics like Seven Samurai and Dog Day Afternoon, to modern favorites like Arrival, Training Day, and Run Lola Run. Whether you’re hunting for hidden gems on Tubi or just want great free movies that actually live up to the hype, this list is built to deliver.

If you’re tired of scrolling endlessly and want free movies on Tubi that are actually worth your time this is the list to watch!
